title: Square MCP Server
summary: Use Square's hosted MCP server to let your agent work with payments, catalog, orders and customers through the Square API after an OAuth sign-in.
description: Square's MCP server exposes its whole API through three tools: one to discover a service's methods, one to read a method's parameters and one to make the call. That keeps the tool list small while covering payments, orders, catalog, customers and more.

The hosted endpoint signs you in with OAuth, so you do not paste an access token. If you prefer to run it yourself with your own token, Square also documents a local npx mode with a DISALLOW_WRITES switch for read-only use.
useWhen: Explore the Square API for a point-of-sale integration
Look up an order and its payments while debugging a mismatch
List catalog items to seed a staging store
Check which fields a Square method requires before you code the call

mcp.name: square
access: Calls the Square API for the seller account you sign in with
Can read and change orders, catalog, customers and payments within that account's permissions

example.prompt: Show the 5 most recent orders at my main location and flag any that have no payment.
example.result: 5 orders returned. Order 7Hk2 (21.50 USD) is OPEN with no tender attached; the other four are completed and paid by card.

faq.question: Can I keep it read-only?
faq.answer: The local npx mode takes DISALLOW_WRITES set to true. The hosted OAuth server follows the permissions you grant when you sign in.

faq.question: Does it work with the Square sandbox?
faq.answer: The local mode has a SANDBOX variable for that. Use it with a sandbox access token while you build.

access: Reads and can change data in the Square seller account you authorize
